# demo_stest — webapp scaffold

Generated by `blocks init demo_stest --mode webapp --agent stest1`.

This page is a thin auth + I/O bridge for `stest1`. The UI is
intentionally minimal — every line in `web/styles.css` is a candidate
for you to delete or replace.

## Local dev

```
blocks dev
```

Opens http://localhost:4242. Sign in with Blocks, fill the textarea(s),
and click Send.

## Deploy

```
blocks deploy cloudflare   # or vercel / netlify
```

## Refreshing against the latest agent card

The scaffold takes a one-shot snapshot of each agent's card at
`blocks init` time. If an agent's card materially changes
(new inputs / outputs / streams), re-run `blocks init` in a fresh
directory to regenerate `web/app.js` against the new card.

See `docs/embed-getting-started.md` for the full walkthrough.
